newsitem.title: UK: Alitalia names new N.Europe cargo GM.
newsitem.headline: Alitalia names new N.Europe cargo GM.

text.p: Alitalia has appointed Walter Migliatico as its new London-based cargo manager for northern Europe, said a spokesman for the airline's cargo department at London-Heathrow.
He said that Migliatico, who took over his new position on January 21, was previously with Alitalia Cargo in Rome but gave no further details.

Migliatico takes over from Paul Rodwell, who is leaving Alitalia in the near future after serving for a year as northern Europe cargo manager, to join handling company the London Cargo Group, a unit of BOC Distribution Services. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
